ArcherHall Leads the Way in Forensics, eDiscovery, and Cybersecurity
At ArcherHall, we specialize in digital forensics and eDiscovery to provide comprehensive litigation support to legal professionals. Our team of experts ensures accurate and defensible data collection, analysis, processing, production, and expert testimony for a wide range of cases, helping you find and present critical evidence
Digital Forensics
For expert collection, preservation, analysis, reporting, and testimony on electronic data – visible, hidden, or deleted – our certified forensic analysts and examiners ensure all data is meticulously examined for accuracy and authenticity to enhance your court case.

Digital Forensics Services
ArcherHall delivers fast, expert digital forensics to uncover, analyze, and present critical evidence—empowering legal teams with clarity, accuracy, and court-trusted results every step of the way.
Forensic Imaging
Create precise, bit-for-bit copies of data from computers, mobile devices, email, and cloud accounts. These copies are admissible in court and are identical to the original, ensuring data integrity throughout the legal process.
Cell Phone Forensics
Our digital forensic examiners specialize in the recovery and analysis of data from cell phones, tablets, and mobile devices, providing key insights for your case.
Data Recovery
Extract data from corrupted or damaged devices. Find and restore deleted files and messages.
Expert Evidence Analysis
Identify files, emails, or activity logs that are relevant to the case. Piece together subtle clues to provide a clear story.
Expert Testimony
Our team provides expert witness testimony, explaining complex digital forensics findings in court in a way that’s easy to understand
Theft of Trade Secrets
Investigate unauthorized access or transfer of sensitive data, ensuring your intellectual property remains secure.
eDiscovery Services
Our eDiscovery services are designed to support law firms, corporations, and government agencies with both large and small data sets. We streamline the electronic discovery process, ensuring Electronically Stored Information (ESI) compliance with court orders or regulatory requests.
Data Collection
Collect data from local, network, or cloud sources from multiple custodians and locations. Our digital forensics examiners ensure the data collection is secure, defensible, and compliant with legal standards.
Processing & Production
Exclude irrelevant data, capture metadata, label and stamp pages and documents, and produce a variety of file types in compliance with ESI protocols.
Hosted Review
Use our secure, cloud-based platform, RelativityOne
®
, to review your documents anywhere. Our project managers help you spend time focusing on your case, not on document management.
Advanced Culling Techniques
Reduce the cost of discovery by filtering out non-relevant and duplicative data, especially if you are dealing with big data environments.
Early Case Assessment
Find out what your data contains before you get too deep. Quickly view data by file type, timeline, or relationships between people.
Electronic Medical Records
Collection, processing, and analysis of Electronic Medical Records (EMR) and associated metadata.
Cybersecurity Services
In addition to digital forensics services, ArcherHall offers robust cybersecurity services to protect your organization. Whether you’re dealing with a data breach or need to ensure compliance, we’ve got you covered.
CMMC Solutions
Preparing your organization for Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC).
Assessments
Your Cybersecurity Assessments Resource for PCI DSS, HIPAA, GLBA, SOX, SOC2/SSAE18, CMMC and more.
Compliance
ArcherHall has over 20 years of experience in cybersecurity compliance and audits.
Protection
Preventative cybersecurity solutions that are designed to make your organization more secure.
Remediation
When it comes to your cybersecurity gaps, ArcherHall gives you options.
